what: Classify three new hir-ty queries in crates/blaze-item-hash/src/reads.rs RULES (and REFUSALS in src/tests/classify.rs if refused), all in hir-ty/src/consteval/discriminants.rs. Why: const_eval_discriminant_variant (same name, same file, still Rule::ConstValue) is now a lookup that reads them, and utils.rs detect_variant_from_bytes (called from valtree, matchck, codegen, the MIR interpreter) now reads enum_discriminants directly, so a step that reaches it would be refused as an unlisted read. Suggested: (1) `explicit_discriminant` keyed by EnumVariantId: Rule::ConstValue, the same fact as const_eval_discriminant_variant of that variant; (2) `explicit_discriminant_indices` keyed by EnumId (which variants are written with `= expr`, read off the syntax, the same data EnumVariants::of holds): Rule::Fields(Of::Enum); (3) `enum_discriminants` keyed by EnumId (every variant's discriminant at once): no single fact names it today; the enum's ConstValue facts of all its variants, or its Layout fact, or a REFUSALS entry with that reason. Your call.
